info.title: Thinking...
info.description: Lino is a tool designed to simplify the development of projects, whether they are distributed, microservices-based, or monolithic.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Lino is a CLI tool created by Tolitech, aimed at speeding up the development of
new projects.
For more information, visit the official website at lino.dev and discover all
the available features.

commands.name: api
commands.description: Manages APIs.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists all APIs linked to the current entity or context.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Creates a new API within the selected service or module.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Manages user authentication features.

commands.description: Logs the user into the Lino CLI.

commands.description: Logs the user out of the tool.

commands.name: build
commands.description:
Builds the defined services and web applications and generates their Docker

commands.name: database
commands.description: Manages the full lifecycle of database migrations.

commands.description: Generates a new database migration.

commands.description: Applies pending migrations in the specified service or module.

commands.description: Lists migrations that have been applied or are pending in the selected context.
